propositions: Add a focused prerequisite-consistency review criterion that evaluates a ticket plan against each direct depends_on/blocks prerequisite without leaking prerequisite material into general finder, verifier, or coach prompts.

Introduce a closed-schema prerequisite coverage contract producing exactly one disposition (consistent, finding, or indeterminate) per readable pinned canonical prerequisite ID with deterministic reason codes.
Keep general and focused Pass-2 verification index domains independently reshaped, then offset and concatenate before a single shared execution-aware Pass 3, so neither domain shifts the other.
Any indeterminate prerequisite record forces a top-level unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict while retained DET blockers remain visible in the blocking array.
Use a canonical four-field length-prefixed SHA-256 encoding for prerequisite-scoped finding IDs while preserving legacy pipe-delimited IDs byte-for-byte for non-prerequisite findings.

Batch prerequisite prompts by token budget with stable lexicographic canonical-ID ordering that never splits the subject or a prerequisite plan block, and prove packed recall/false-acceptance non-regression against a pinned singleton baseline.
